## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.11

This release improves the general GrowAssistant Debug sensor with phase-aware diagnostics.

### Phase-aware diagnostics

The general Debug entity now reports diagnostics that match the current crop-steering phase instead of always exposing P1-oriented readiness information.

New and improved diagnostics include:

- Machine-readable `phase_reason`
- Phase-aware `blocking_reasons`
- Phase-aware `passed_conditions`
- Correct distinction between P1 start-readiness and active-P1 shot conditions
- P2 sensor-mode diagnostics based on VWC/drop and safety gates
- No interval gating in P2 sensor mode
- P3 phase reasons based on actual phase-selection logic
- Operational P2 blockers remain visible without being misreported as the cause of P3
- Light-off P3 reports `light_cycle_ended`

### Compatibility

- The existing P1 Debug sensor remains available and unchanged.
- The existing Block Reason sensor remains available and unchanged.
- No irrigation logic, Blueprint behavior, phase-selection logic, or pump-control behavior was changed.
